summary: Clipper for drums, buses and masters: drive into a ceiling in dBFS, with a hard, soft (cubic), tanh or knee curve, 1× to 8× oversampling with antiderivative anti-aliasing, up to three bands (zero-latency Linkwitz–Riley crossovers, each band driven on its own), left/right or mid/side, mix, output, Delta (hear what it takes away) and a gain-match reading. No sample leaves above the ceiling at Mix 100 %; its latency is the same at every setting. Use it before a true-peak limiter to shave transients the limiter would pump on, or on drums for weight.
use_for: Shave peaks off drums, buses or the master with a hard, soft or knee clip.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Gain into the clipper in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Raises the level going into the clipper by -12 to +24 dB, so more of the signal reaches the ceiling.
parameters.sound: More drive makes the track louder and denser, with more crunch as the peaks are flattened.

parameters.name: Ceiling
parameters.description: Where it clips, dBFS (0.1 dB steps): no sample leaves above it at Mix 100 %
parameters.how: Sets the level in dBFS, from -24 to 0, at which the clipper flattens or bends the signal.
parameters.sound: Lower ceilings cut the peaks harder, so the sound becomes quieter overall and more squashed at the top.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.description: Hard: flat at the ceiling. Soft: a cubic that bends from 0 and reaches the ceiling at 1.5× it. Tanh: the tanh curve, the ceiling its asymptote. Knee: straight up to Knee under the ceiling, then a quadratic bend into it
parameters.how: Chooses the curve that treats the peaks: Hard flat cut, Soft cubic bend, Tanh round bend, or Knee, straight until just under the ceiling.
parameters.sound: Hard is the edgiest and loudest, Soft and Tanh are rounder and warmer, and Knee stays clean until it bends.

parameters.name: Knee
parameters.description: Knee shape: where the bend starts, this far under the ceiling (0: hard)
parameters.how: Sets how far under the ceiling the Knee shape starts to bend, from 0 to 12 dB.
parameters.sound: A wider knee rounds the transition so peaks sound smoother; 0 dB acts like a hard cut.

parameters.name: Oversampling
parameters.description: Oversampling, with first-order antiderivative anti-aliasing from 2× (1×: the curve as it is, aliasing). The latency is the same at every setting
parameters.how: Runs the clipper at 1, 2, 4 or 8 times the sample rate so the flattened edges do not fold back into the audible range.
parameters.sound: At 1x bright material can sound gritty from aliasing; higher settings sound clean.

parameters.name: Bands
parameters.description: One band, or two or three split by Linkwitz–Riley crossovers (zero latency), each clipped on its own and summed, then clipped again
parameters.how: Splits the signal into one, two or three bands and clips each band on its own before summing them.
parameters.sound: With several bands a loud bass no longer drags the highs into clipping, so the result is cleaner at the same loudness.

parameters.name: Crossover 1
parameters.description: Between the low and the next band (−6 dB here)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, where the low band ends and the next band starts.
parameters.sound: Lower values give only the deep bass its own clipper; higher values let the clipper handle more of the body.

parameters.name: Crossover 2
parameters.description: Between the mid and the high band with three bands (never below Crossover 1)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between the middle and high bands when three bands are in use.
parameters.sound: It decides how much of the upper midrange is clipped together with the highs rather than with the mids.

parameters.name: Low drive
parameters.description: The low band's drive against Drive (bands only)
parameters.how: Adds or removes up to 12 dB of drive for the low band, relative to Drive.
parameters.sound: Raising it makes the bass denser and louder; lowering it keeps the lows clean.

parameters.name: Mid drive
parameters.description: The middle band's drive against Drive (three bands)
parameters.how: Adds or removes up to 12 dB of drive for the middle band, relative to Drive.
parameters.sound: Raising it thickens the midrange and vocals; lowering it keeps them natural.

parameters.name: High drive
parameters.description: The high band's drive against Drive (bands only)
parameters.how: Adds or removes up to 12 dB of drive for the high band, relative to Drive.
parameters.sound: Raising it makes the top brighter and fizzier; lowering it keeps cymbals and air smooth.

parameters.name: Stereo
parameters.description: What is clipped: left and right, or mid and side (then left and right again at the ceiling)
parameters.how: Chooses whether the clipper works on left and right, or on mid and side.
parameters.sound: Left/right can pull the image sideways on lopsided peaks; mid/side clips the centre and the width separately.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is delayed to match). Below 100 % the dry signal can pass the ceiling
parameters.how: Blends the clipped signal with the dry signal, delayed to line up with it.
parameters.sound: Below 100 % some natural dynamics come back, but dry peaks can pass the ceiling.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the clipper, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)
parameters.how: Adds -24 to +24 dB of gain after the clipper.
parameters.sound: It lets you match the loudness to the unclipped sound so you judge the tone rather than the volume.

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the clipper changes: the output minus the input, delayed to match (gliding over 10 ms)
parameters.how: Plays only the difference between the clipper's output and its input.
parameters.sound: You hear just what the clipper removed or added, which shows what it costs the sound.

readings.description: Short-term loudness out − in (K-weighted, 3 s): what Output would have to take back for equal loudness
How far the driven signal went over the ceiling, at most
Samples the curve bent (over the knee, or the ceiling in Hard)
The clipper's latency, reported to NeoBuzz Live
